_comment: Weight manifest for Qwen-Image-2.1 as packaged by the ComfyUI org.
Sizes and SHA256 values were read from the HuggingFace LFS metadata and
checked against the bytes on disk after download. base_url pins a repo
revision rather than 'main', so a re-upload upstream fails loudly instead
of silently changing what you get.
Weights are NOT redistributed by this repo. They are fetched from
HuggingFace and covered by the Qwen Research License, which is far more
restrictive than this repo's MIT license - see LICENSE-MODELS.md.

files.note: 7B DiT, int8 rotation-based quantization. Near-lossless vs bf16.
Qwen3-VL-8B text encoder, int8. Default choice.
4-bit weights. 3GB smaller, ~700MB less VRAM. Measured no adherence loss on counting, dense text or spatial-negation prompts - use it if VRAM is tight.
